verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint is documented to convert documents into structured JSON with layout and formatting, and explicitly 'handles multi-column text, nested tables, forms with handwriting, rotated pages,' with each element carrying type, page position and confidence. The r-1 model is documented to do full-page layout parsing with bounding boxes, and chunking splits at section headers, so the core of the story is covered by first-party docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of header/footer and footnote handling, explicit reading-order guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration of accuracy on complex layouts.
